headline: Wack 100 Calls Out Akademiks in Viral Instagram Post
body: DJ Akademiks shared an Instagram post on September 10, 2026, where a user named Wack 100 publicly called out Akademiks. The post, which garnered 6,116 likes and 1,063 comments, has sparked immediate discussion in hip-hop circles. The caption reads: "Wack 100 calls out Akademiks 😳". This viral moment highlights the ongoing tension between these artists in the rap community.
